Apple Launches macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 Release Candidates

舊版 macOS 繼續獲得安全性更新

Continuing its tradition of minor updates for older macOS versions, Apple today rolled out the first release candidates for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, without having previously seeded any standard beta builds.

Apple last month released macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.1, each of which went through two release candidate stages before being pushed out publicly.

The release notes Apple has written for the first release candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 mention only that the updates "provide[s] important security fixes and are recommended for all users." Last month's update included a CoreGraphics security fix, which is described as:

Apple will likely detail the patches included in macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 once they're released publicly, which is anticipated to happen sometime in the coming weeks alongside macOS 27.2 Golden Gate.

macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 RC 1 is build number 24H219, while macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RC 1 is build number 25G320.

Have you found any new features or changes in today's release candidates? Let us know in the comments.
